title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for diabetes and neuropathy.

HPI
The patient is a 72-year-old woman presenting today for a routine follow-up regarding her type 2 diabetes and associated polyneuropathy. She reports that her blood glucose levels remain stable. She manages her condition exclusively through lifestyle modifications and reports adherence to her current routine. She describes a persistent tingling sensation in her toes and feet, which she identifies as her peripheral neuropathy. She denies any new acute symptoms or significant changes in her daily activities.

Medication List
Diet and exercise only.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Physical examination of the lower extremities reveals decreased sensation to light touch in the bilateral feet. Motor strength is intact in the lower extremities. Skin is intact without ulcerations or signs of infection.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus, currently diet controlled.
2. Polyneuropathy.

Plan
The patient will continue to manage her type 2 diabetes through diet and exercise. We will continue to monitor her peripheral neuropathy symptoms. She was instructed to report any new foot wounds or changes in sensation immediately. Follow-up in six months.

Electronically signed, J. Lindqvist, DO, 05/12/2026
explanations: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: the combination code E11.42 captures both.

distractors.why: Coding the two separately misses the presumed link.
